newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian output shows first signs of upturn - IRS.
newsitem.headline: Italian output shows first signs of upturn - IRS.

text.p: Italian industrial output is expected to show signs of an upturn in February for the first time in several months, leading indicators from Italian private research group IRS showed.
IRS said factors likely to have a positive effect included a much lower level of stocks of finished products, a slight rising trend in orders and an easier monetary policy.
Latest official data showed Italian unadjusted industrial output fell 5.9 percent year-on-year in November after an October rise of 0.3 percent.
